prefix.description: first characters of the key, to recognise it

restored_at.description: when the last restore finished, 0 = never or still running

ignore.description: patterns to leave out, one per line (e.g. logs, *.tmp, cache/)

docker_image.description: the default image (the first of docker_images)

location.description: Where the error occurred, e.g. 'body.items[3].tags' or 'path.thing-id'

value.description: The value at the given location

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
examples: Property foo is required but is missing.

errors.description: Optional list of individual error details

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. This value should not change between occurrences of the error.

type.description: A URI reference to human-readable documentation for the error.

root.description: the folder the archive is made in; paths must be inside it

path.description: copied next to itself as "<name> copy"

root.description: where to extract; defaults to the archive's folder

moves.description: rename or move; parent folders are created

path.description: a folder ending in / (the file keeps its name) or a full file path

code.description: authenticator or recovery code; required when two-factor is on

backup_limit.description: how many backups this server may keep

cpuset.description: pin to cores, e.g. 0-3 or 0,2; empty = any

port_limit.description: ports the owner may add beyond the primary one (default 0)

swap_mb.description: extra swap on top of memory: 0 = none, -1 = unlimited

pending.description: the server must restart to use the change

disk_mb.description: disk servers may use in total, 0 = not tracked

memory_mb.description: memory servers may use in total, 0 = not tracked

token.description: Shown once. Set as GAMEPANEL_NODE_TOKEN on the daemon.

port.description: admins only; 0 = the next free port

cron.description: 5 fields (UTC): minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week

only_when_online.description: skip runs while the server is not running
